# SkillPouch

> SkillPouch publishes a curated, evidence-backed Agent skills directory organized across 8 directories, 16 three-stage workflow tasks, and 34 deduplicated selected skills. Pages document stage fit rationale, pinned git revisions, SPDX licenses, and known limitations. This website is not a popularity ranking, does not issue official Agent compatibility certifications, and is separate from the SkillPouch desktop application's signed configuration endpoint.

## Entry Points

- [English Home](https://skillpouch.tools.place/en/index.html)
- [简体中文首页](https://skillpouch.tools.place/zh/index.html)
- [Privacy Policy / 隐私政策](https://skillpouch.tools.place/en/privacy.html) ([zh-Hans](https://skillpouch.tools.place/zh/privacy.html))
- [Terms of Use / 使用协议](https://skillpouch.tools.place/en/terms.html) ([zh-Hans](https://skillpouch.tools.place/zh/terms.html))
- [Contact Us / 联系我们](https://skillpouch.tools.place/en/contact.html) ([zh-Hans](https://skillpouch.tools.place/zh/contact.html))
- [XML Sitemap](https://skillpouch.tools.place/sitemap.xml)
